mapper.select: SELECT type_code typeCode,name,status,parent_type_code parentTypeCode FROM sys_dict_type WHERE parent_type_code='ECOMMERCE' OR type_code='MERCHANT_TYPE' ORDER BY sort_order,id

SELECT i.id,i.type_code typeCode,i.item_code itemCode FROM showcase_shop_type t JOIN sys_dict_item i ON i.item_code=t.type_code JOIN sys_dict_type d ON d.type_code=i.type_code WHERE t.id=#{id} AND (d.parent_type_code='ECOMMERCE' OR d.type_code='MERCHANT_TYPE') FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.id,t.type_code typeCode,t.name,t.description,t.status,t.sort_order sortOrder,i.type_code categoryCode FROM showcase_shop_type t JOIN sys_dict_item i ON i.item_code=t.type_code JOIN sys_dict_type d ON d.type_code=i.type_code WHERE t.type_code=#{code} AND (d.parent_type_code='ECOMMERCE' OR d.type_code='MERCHANT_TYPE')
mapper.update: INSERT INTO showcase_shop_type(type_code,name,description,status,sort_order) SELECT i.item_code,i.name,LEFT(i.description,300), CASE WHEN d.status='ENABLED' AND i.status='ENABLED' AND (d.parent_type_code IS NULL OR parent.status='ENABLED') THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END,i.sort_order FROM sys_dict_item i JOIN sys_dict_type d ON d.type_code=i.type_code LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type parent ON parent.type_code=d.parent_type_code WHERE i.type_code='MERCHANT_TYPE' OR d.parent_type_code='ECOMMERCE' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name=VALUES(name),description=VALUES(description),status=VALUES(status),sort_order=VALUES(sort_order)
UPDATE showcase_product p JOIN showcase_shop_type t ON t.id=p.type_id SET p.category=t.name,p.status=CASE WHEN t.status='DISABLED' AND p.status='PUBLISHED' THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE p.status END
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM showcase_shop_type WHERE type_code=#{itemCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM showcase_shop_type_rel WHERE type_code=#{itemCode}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM showcase_product p JOIN showcase_shop_type t ON t.id=p.type_id WHERE t.type_code=#{itemCode})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_type WHERE parent_type_code=#{typeCode}

where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR type_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR item_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM ORDER BY sort_order,id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,type_code typeCode,parent_type_code parentTypeCode,status FROM sys_dict_type WHERE type_code=#{typeCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_item WHERE type_code=#{typeCode}
